schema.idea: Monthly spike in FRED series of US industrial wage growth signals rising macro input pressure

data.source: FRED US industrial average hourly earnings series

schema.behavior: Rapid wage growth in industrial sectors signals rising input cost pressure that may squeeze margins.

market_impact.rationale: Rising labor costs pressure industrial profitability and can reduce capital expenditure plans.

trade_logic.entry: If monthly industrial wage growth exceeds 0.5% month-over-month
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 2 months or when wage growth falls below 0.3% month-over-month

schema.reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Wage data releases are monthly and often show growth exceeding thresholds during inflationary periods.
